inlines.v: EUPHON'IC EUPHON'ICAL, adjective [See Euphony.] Agreeable in sound; pleasing to the ear; as euphonical orthography. The Greeks adopted many changes in the combination of syllables to render their language euphonic by avoiding such collisions.
